messages:
jen_cs: Quick thread for Caldera renewal (hosted -> private hybrid). They want SOC2 attestation before exec, plus a data residency clause for EU-only data handling. Also asked whether we can invoice at kickoff (full amount) instead of prorate. Need alignment on risk + timeline.

marco_fin: Finance prefers invoicing on term start, but if they want full upfront we need Sales approval and updated billing terms. Net30 is typical; Caldera wants Net45 and upfront. @jen_cs any guidance from AE?

jen_cs: AE confirmed CFO prefers single upfront invoice for accounting simplicity. They're okay with Net45 on renewal invoice. Sales tentatively OK if we give 8% early-pay discount.

lila_legal: SOC2: we can provide SOC2 type II report but cannot add report into contract; we can reference SOC2 in the security addendum. For data residency clause, need precise language: do they want logical separation, physical hosting in EU region, or both?

aisha_onboarding: From onboarding calls: they require EU-hosted embeddings + logs never leave EU. They also asked about KMS key residency. That may be a Private deployment requirement.

tom_ops: If they need customer-managed keys in EU HSM, that's a Private-only feature. Hosted can offer SEA/UK/EU region hosting but not external HSM customer keys. Will flag as scope change.

marco_fin: So options: (A) Hosted with EU data controls + standard SOC2 + upfront invoice with 8% discount + Net45, or (B) Private with customer KMS + EU residency but longer lead time and higher price. Which does Caldera want?

jen_cs: Caldera wants the cheaper/fastest path if compliance satisfied. Ask: can hosted guarantee logs and embeddings remain in EU region for retention window?

aisha_onboarding: Yes hosted EU region keeps data in region, but backups and some telemetry may go to central monitoring; need to confirm retention and telemetry redaction. I'll get the exact telemetry doc link.

lila_legal: Draft clause suggestion for EU residency: "Redwood shall store and process Customer Personal Data originating from the EU exclusively within EU regions and shall not transfer such data outside the EU except as required by law or with Customer's prior written consent." Is that acceptable as starting point?

jen_cs: That looks good to start. Can you also add a line about logs/embeddings and key management?

lila_legal: Addendum line: "Model outputs and associated KV cache, embeddings, and logs for EU accounts will be stored in EU regions; Customer-managed encryption keys are required for Private deployments only."

tom_ops: Note: we should include an operational exception: cross-region metrics and anonymized telemetry may be aggregated in US. Suggest: "Anonymized service metrics may be aggregated outside EU; Customer data fields will not be included." Need to get engineering sign-off.

marco_fin: On invoicing: Sales to confirm discount. If AE confirms 8% and CFO sends PO, Finance can do upfront invoice with Net45. Provide PO# and billing entity.

jen_cs: AE is getting PO now. They asked for a one-page summary to attach to their procurement. I'll draft a short bullet PDF with the offered terms (9mo suggested term? they didn't confirm term length yet).

aisha_onboarding: Also flag: if they choose Private for KMS, timeline is ~6 weeks for provisioning + network. That will push renewal beyond month-end.

lila_legal: I'll create a redline of the renewal SOW with the EU residency addendum and SOC2 reference. Posting here once ready.

tom_ops: I'll ask infra for a brief note on telemetry and backup location for EU accounts and paste it here.

jen_cs: Timeline: we need signed SOW + PO by next Wednesday to keep start date. Targeting to close by Tue COB. Thanks all :raised_hands:

marco_fin: I'll standby for PO and discount approval. Please tag me when PO arrives.

jen_cs: PO received via DM from AE (PO-CA-4321), forwarding to Finance + attaching draft summary. Will update when legal redlines post.
